documented_probe: C-b18a585c (split oversized files to respect a size limit): reference floor is medium and this task is medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases (multiple caps/sizes, header framing, corrupt set must fail closed, error invocations).
notes: Single-deliverable framing tool: fragment an oversized file into headered frames each within a byte cap, with a checksum manifest, plus lossless reassembly and an audit mode that fails closed on tampered frames. Differs from the prior splitting task by the 16-byte in-band header arithmetic (cap must exceed the header), sha256 manifest integrity, an audit subcommand, empty-input K=0 semantics, and no-output-on-corruption. Rubric weights reasoning_depth (header/framing arithmetic), adversarial_inputs (corrupt set, bad caps), hidden_case_generalization (unseen input/cap pairs) and quantitative_correctness (exact bytes/counts); totals bucket to medium.
